name: Paired Perturbation Replay
mechanism: Runs baseline and candidate on matched task and environment identities under clean and controlled perturbations to isolate regressions and robustness effects.
use_when: A change claim needs causal comparison against the current baseline
Tool noise memory contamination or environment variance are material risks
avoid_when: Task or environment identities differ between variants
One stochastic attempt is being treated as conclusive
expected_effects: Failure attribution to specific information channels
failure_modes: Perturbation is unrealistic or leaks the expected answer
Aggregate score hides a high-risk regression slice
